name: Alt OI-flush beta (1h long, ATR-scaled stop for alt volatility)
rationale: MECHANISM (H5 on 1h with an ATR-scaled stop): alts are more volatile than BTC, so a fixed percent stop is systematically wrong; sizing the stop as an ATR-multiple at entry lets protection scale with the alt's own cascade volatility, the honest way to survive the knife-edge before the over-shot rebound. A 1h bar reads the deeper, decisive alt flushes. The spot float anchors the snap-back; counterparty is thin-book alt liquidation flow. SPOT long. Entry: open_interest cross_down through a DEEP negative floor AND rsi below a low oversold floor AND ret_Nd below a negative floor (falling) AND vol_realized above a floor. DISCONFIRMER: cross-asset ablation vs BTC-only — equal performance kills the alt-idiosyncratic thesis; per-symbol not pooled — outlier-carried edge is an artifact; the ATR stop must not merely fatten the loser tail. Must beat BH net of fees, maxDD <= 25%.
catalyst: 1h deep alt OI flush + oversold + falling, held on an ATR-scaled stop
